key_insight: A well-balanced WE-PINN formulation exactly preserves lake-at-rest equilibria over smooth and discontinuous bathymetry while resolving shallow-water flows across bottom steps.
engineering_relevance: The method supports mesh-free shallow-water simulation without spurious motion at equilibrium, including terrain with abrupt elevation changes.
method: Enforce weak space–time conservation on randomly placed, potentially overlapping control volumes without differentiating the network.
Integrate the geometric source by parts and correct local bed slopes so quadrature reproduces exact bed increments.
Use independent networks across bed discontinuities, coupled by conservation of discharge and total head.
evidence_signal: Four lake-at-rest configurations yielded residuals at round-off, and seven bottom-step Riemann tests achieved relative L1 free-surface errors of 6.9×10⁻⁴–3.5×10⁻³.
watch_item: Exact equilibrium preservation by the objective does not guarantee rapid training convergence; reaching equilibrium to round-off required an extended training budget.
paper_title: Well-Balanced WE-PINNs for the Shallow Water Equations over Smooth and Discontinuous Bathymetries
